question: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages
sql:
WITH monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as month_year,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as total_deposits,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as total_withdrawals,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) as month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE CAST(txn_date AS DATE) >= '2020-01-01' AND CAST(txn_date AS DATE) <= '2020-12-31'
    GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(txn_date AS DATE))
),
customer_month_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        COUNT(*) as customer_count
    FROM monthly_balances
    WHERE month_end_balance > 0
    GROUP BY month_year
),
highest_month AS (
    SELECT month_year FROM customer_month_counts ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1
),
lowest_month AS (
    SELECT month_year FROM customer_month_counts ORDER BY customer_count ASC LIMIT 1
),
avg_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        ROUND(AVG(month_end_balance), 2) as avg_balance
    FROM monthly_balances
    GROUP BY month_year
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT month_year FROM highest_month) as highest_count_month,
    (SELECT customer_count FROM customer_month_counts WHERE month_year = (SELECT month_year FROM highest_month)) as highest_count,
    (SELECT month_year FROM lowest_month) as lowest_count_month,
    (SELECT customer_count FROM customer_month_counts WHERE month_year = (SELECT month_year FROM lowest_month)) as lowest_count,
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE month_year = (SELECT month_year FROM highest_month)) as highest_month_avg,
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE month_year = (SELECT month_year FROM lowest_month)) as lowest_month_avg,
    ROUND(((SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE month_year = (SELECT month_year FROM highest_month)) - 
           (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE month_year = (SELECT month_year FROM lowest_month))), 2) as difference
